message:
Wow, this is brilliant. I completely agree with you that it never would have worked without a group of strong students. I can imagine that at a lot of places, upper administration might shut down a project like this if faced with complaints from students and/or parents.

I'd like to see the work here connected in some way to the Framework for Success in Postsecondary Writing. It sounds like these students are (already were, that is) outstanding with regard to the eight habits of mind in the Framework (especially persistence!); do you think this class helped them internalize these habits even more?
